functionalReqs: Ingest documents from several sources and keep them in sync
Answer natural-language questions with cited sources
Users only see answers from documents they can access
Say 'I don't know' when the documents don't cover it
hints: Why not stuff every document into the prompt? What limits you?
The pipeline has an offline half (ingest, chunk, embed, index) and an online half (retrieve, re-rank, generate). What happens to permissions in each?

Connectors → parse → chunk (structure-aware, ~500 tokens with overlap) → embed → vector DB with metadata and ACLs; query rewriting with chat history → hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vectors) filtered by ACL → cross-encoder re-rank → LLM prompt with numbered sources and instructions to cite or abstain; incremental re-indexing; evaluation with a golden Q&A set (faithfulness, answer relevance, retrieval recall).
problemStatement:
Design an **internal Q&A assistant** that answers employees' questions using the company's documents (Confluence, Google Drive, PDFs) with citations.

Answers must be grounded in the documents, respect access permissions, and stay current as documents change.
title: Design a RAG-based Document Q&A System
